msg: DESIGN TARGET (blocks.md s2). Independent frequency-domain read of the same chain gain b1 measures in DC - a wrong gain resistor trips both. Measured 139.235 V/V.
REQUIREMENTS Q9: response flat within about 1 % at 1 kHz. Design 0.03 %, measured 0.0293 %.

DESIGN TARGET (blocks.md B3, design 41 kHz). REQUIREMENTS Q9's 1 % droop at 1 kHz needs only about 7 kHz for a single pole; 20 kHz is blocks.md's own floor. Measured 38.7 kHz. NOTE: the trigger level is hard-coded at 39.875 dB (design gain 20*log10(139.24) minus 3 dB) because ngspice evaluates `when val` at parse time; a wrong DC gain makes this measure MISSING, which the gate reports as an error.
DESIGN TARGET (blocks.md B3): no peaking anywhere 1 Hz..1 MHz. Measured 2e-10 dB. This is the whole-chain number; the output stage's own margin into a 1 nF cable is b11's job.
DESIGN TARGET. Shape check one decade above the signal band: 42.63 dB against 42.88 dB at DC.
